tha-ap520:1.1: Ghosasaññaka.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe vivane ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ devasaṅghapurakkhataṃ // //
tha-ap520:2.1: Catusaccaṃ pakāsentaṃ desantaṃ amataṃ padaṃ / assosiṃ madhuraṃ dhammaṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap520:3.1: Ghose cittaṃ pasādesiṃ asamappaṭipuggalaṃ / tatth cittaṃ pasādetvā atariṃ duttaraṃ bhavaṃ. // //
tha-ap520:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ghosasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap520:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ghosasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
